Technology Overview Resources Contact Us Schedule a Demo Air2Road – Multimodal Localization Air2Road, driven by Liquid AI technology, delivers precise centimeter-level accuracy by seamlessly matching aerial imagery with real-time ground view from the vehicle’s cameras. Schedule a call Schedule a demo Overview Overview Technical Highlights Use Cases Advantages Partners Air2Road Setting localization standards for automated driving. Utilizing Autobrains’ Signature-based AI, Air2Road matches aerial imagery with vehicle camera data to deliver highly accurate localization. The multimodal system enables centimeter-level precision, enhancing the safety of automated driving. The Challenge Traditional localization systems relying on GNSS or crowd-sourced maps face challenges like limited coverage, high costs, interference, and single source data inaccuracies. The Solution Air2Road delivers precise, real-time vehicle localization for safe navigation, even in challenging conditions such as occlusions, adverse weather, and complex urban environments. Air2Road – Technical Highlights Driven by Liquid AI, Air2Road focuses on features critical for localization. By matching two independent modalities, aerial imagery with 360 vehicle camera data, it achieves centimeter-level localization. CM-Level Accuracy Centimeter-level precision for unparalleled accuracy and reliability. Multimodal Sensor Input Matching visual aerial with ground-level data inputs. Signature Technology Sparse binary hyperdimensional driving environment representations. Use Cases Air2Road Performance within Different Driving Scenarios From bustling urban areas to rural roads, Air2Road adapts to all driving scenarios, including dense city centers and tree-covered routes. Urban Urban Parking Lot Tree-Covered Localization in Urban Setting. Precise localization in urban environments. Technology Used: Self-Learned Signatures for aerial and ground view matching. Precise localization in parking lots. Focusing only on localization-relevant static objects while ignoring parked and moving vehicles. Technology Used: Self-Learned Signatures for aerial and ground view matching. Stability under trees or bridges. Ensuring reliability even in occluded scenarios and across environmental or seasonal variations in both aerial and ground inputs. Technology Used: Self-Learned Signatures for aerial and ground view matching. Full Coverage Unlike GNSS-based systems, Air2Road’s Signature-based technology operates reliably in challenging environments, such as under trees, bridges, between buildings, and in areas with poor GNSS signal. Scalable and Efficient Existing systems like crowd-sourced maps need a fleet for data collection before localization. Air2Road offers instant localization for the first vehicle, enabling scalable deployment without losing accuracy. Cost-Effective Air2Road uses affordable aerial imagery from various vendors. Its compressed Signatures tech stores large areas on the vehicle, enabling a low-memory, low-bandwidth system without continuous cloud connectivity. Environment-Aware Path Planning By utilizing real-time data on road conditions, traffic flow, and parking areas, Air2Road enhances safety and enables more optimized navigation. Design Win in China With Planned ADAS SOP in Q4 2024 Collaboration with Top OEM on L4 Project Ensuring GSR & NCAP Compliance Strategic Partnerships Autobrains collaborates with the top global automotive players. Contact Us "AD 3.0 is the next step in autonomy. Using an agentic AI approach, we are bringing scalable, robust autonomous driving to every car." Igal Raichelgauz CEO & Founder 300 + Patents 100 + AI Talents & Automotive Experts >$ 140 M Funds Raised Introducing Autobrains Redefining Autonomous Driving with Thinking AI Backed by over 300 patents, cutting-edge research, and more than $140 million in funding, Autobrains is developing a new approach to autonomy. We build Thinking AI – an Agentic AI based approach that enables vehicles to understand context, assess risk, and make decisions in real time, bringing scalable autonomous driving to every car. Our Mission Our mission is to bring autonomy to every car. Through Thinking AI and an agentic approach, we are bringing AD 3.0 to the industry – delivering scalable, low-cost solutions that run on standard sensors and minimal compute. Leadership Our Leadership Team Igal Raichelgauz Founder & CEO Igal Raichelgauz is the Founder and CEO of Autobrains and Co-Founder and Chairman of Cortica, a pioneer in self-learning AI technology. With a background spanning electrical engineering, computer science, and neuroscience, Igal has been at the forefront of AI innovation for over a decade. Under his leadership, Autobrains has raised over $140 million and built a portfolio of more than 300 patents, positioning the company at the center of the next phase of autonomous driving. Igal began his career in elite military intelligence before co-founding Figment, an advanced messaging platform, and later serving as CTO of LCB, a speech recognition company. His academic research at the Technion in cortical neural networks laid the foundation for his approach to artificial intelligence. In 2007, Igal co-founded Cortica, an AI company known for its self-learning technology in visual perception, where he led the creation of multiple AI ventures across industries, including Autobrains in autonomous driving. At Autobrains, Igal is leading the transition to AD 3.0 through Thinking AI – an agentic approach that enables vehicles to understand context, assess risk, and make decisions in real time. This architecture allows scalable autonomous driving using standard sensors and efficient compute, bringing robust autonomy to every car. Igal holds over 50 patents and has received multiple awards for innovation. He is a frequent speaker at global industry events, where he shares his perspective on the future of AI and the evolution of autonomous driving. Karl-Thomas Neumann Chairman Karl Thomas joined Autobrains as an investor and a management team member following a career in the automotive industry that span over three decades. Over the years Karl-Thomas was the CEO of Continental AG, Opel AG and Volkswagen Group China. Karl-Thomas brings with him to Autobrains wealth of experience in Corporate Governance, Product Development, Marketing Strategy, Business Strategy and Automotive industry understanding. In recent years he got involved in the startup arena, focusing on innovation in the eMobility domain. Karl-Thomas completed his Ph.D. in Electrical & Electronics Engineering from the University of Dortmund in 1987. Awy Julianto Board Member Awy Julianto is the Founder & Managing Partner of Altitude Partners, an investment advisory firm active across the US, China, Israel, UK, and Southeast Asia. He works closely with Horizon Ventures and has invested in companies such as Zoom, SpaceX, Impossible Foods, and Animoca. Awy is also Chairman of Alto Dio Inc., a multi-strategy investment firm. In 2022, Awy joined the Board of Autobrains, along side his role as special advisor. Our Management Team Ziv Leitman CFO Ziv joined Autobrains as Chief Financial Officer, leveraging his 30+ years of experience in managing global finance teams and complex business processes. He has held several CFO roles at leading enterprises such as Comverse, Partner, Paz, Lucent, DIC, Orbotech, and Allot. Ziv is a Certified Public Accountant and holds a B.A. in Economics and Accounting, as well as an M.B.A. in Finance and Information Systems, both from Tel Aviv University. Adam Harel SVP R&D Adam is leading the Automotive R&D at Autobrains , He Joined Cortica in July 2013, and moved to lead the development work in Autobrains after it was founded. Adam brings a vast knowledge and extensive experience in the field of computer vision, machine learning and Image processing. Adam holds a Bachelor degree from the department of Biomedical Engineering of Tel Aviv University. Prior to that Adam served in an elite intelligence unit in the IDF. Doron Chen COO Doron Chen the COO of Autobrains Technologies, overseeing corporate development, investor relations, legal affairs, and regulatory compliance. With a strong background in senior management, he drives strategic growth through fundraising, M&A, and deal sourcing, leveraging both business and legal expertise. Previously, he served as a Senior Corporate Associate at Herzog, Fox & Neeman, advising tech companies, VCs, and multinational firms. Doron holds an MBA in Finance and an LL.B. from The Hebrew University of Jerusalem. Our Advisory Board Michael Pozsar Before leaving Aptiv in July 2019, Michael was Vice President Global Product Lines at Aptiv. In this role, Michael had P&L ($3.5B) responsibility for five global product lines: Advanced Safety; Infotainment; User Experience; Connectivity & Security and; Automated Driving Systems (SaaS) for OEM customers.

Technology Overview Resources Contact Us Schedule a Demo In the Heart of Europe’s Automotive Industry: Autobrains Opens New Munich Office – Expanding its International Footprint On the road of continuous growth, Autobrains – an AI leader in the automotive industry headquartered in Tel Aviv – is intensifying its European and international activities by opening a new site in Munich. TEL AVIV, ISRAEL, MUNICH, GERMANY – February 2024: Autobrains, an automotive AI pioneer and developer of revolutionary signature-based self-learning AI, has achieved a major milestone in maturing its AI products and technologies. With soaring customer engagement, the company is poised for the next phase of growth. The strategy includes establishing a physical presence in Europe’s automotive hub. Autobrains is thrilled to announce the launch of its new subsidiary and office in Munich, Germany. This strategic expansion into Germany marks a pivotal step in ascending to the next level of maturity and signals the company’s commitment to making an impactful entrance into the ADAS sector. In a significant development last year, Autobrains has accomplished several impressive milestones, which include: The successful onboarding of industry professionals Hilla Tavor and Uri Yacovy to lead Autobrains’ business development and operational strategies. Both transitioned from Mobileye, bringing with them years of experience from high-tech, automotive, and security companies, thereby elevating the company’s operational excellence. The amplification of its recruitment initiatives, aimed at attracting the top echelons of AI and automotive expertise within Europe. The establishment of Autobrains’ Munich office, a move that not only brings the company into direct alignment with European Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) but also enables it to tap into the rich vein of local talent. The Munich site marks a key expansion of the company’s base. Igal Raichelgauz, CEO and founder of Autobrains, shares, “We believe that our presence in Munich will serve as a catalyst for nurturing partnerships, fostering innovation, and propelling Autobrains to the forefront of AI-driven automotive solutions.” Located in the heart of Europe, the new office guarantees excellent connections to existing and potential partners and customers inside and outside of Germany. The office and the team in Munich are a natural next step in what has been a period of Autobrains’ sustained growth. It is clear evidence that the company is continuing to expand its global footprint. The Munich office will be the hub for Autobrains’ European demonstration vehicles, providing an ideal environment for developing, testing and refining the company’s AI capabilities. Germany’s specific safety requirements for ADAS and AD systems serve as a benchmark for international standards and guide the work of Autobrains’ developers. The Autobrains team is dedicated to designing assistance systems and autonomous driving functions that not only meet but exceed these high safety standards. Systems that secure approval for the German market can be readily adapted to meet the requirements of other geos, showcasing the global adaptability and commitment to safety inherent in Autobrains’ technology. TEL AVIV, Israel & MUNICH, Germany, May 21, 2024 (Newswire.com) - Autobrains, a disrupter in automotive artificial intelligence (AI) and Advanced Driver Safety Systems (ADAS), today announced their nomination, which will see Autobrains’ innovative software, Liquid AI, deployed in a new line of vehicles developed by a leading Chinese Electric Vehicle manufacturer. Production of these new vehicles is expected to begin during Q4, 2024. Autobrains has established the development of revolutionary AI solutions, including its flagship Liquid AI technology, which has been central to addressing the most complex challenges in today's automotive AI landscape. While details of the partner remain confidential, the collaboration is set to redefine industry standards and accelerate the adoption of advanced driver-assistance systems across the automotive sector. Igal Raichelgauz, Founder and CEO of Autobrains, commented, "Teaming up with a leading Chinese automotive player reinforces the exceptional performance and adaptability of our advanced AI systems. By integrating our cutting-edge technology with their robust manufacturing capabilities, we are creating a new paradigm shift for what AI in vehicles can achieve. Our shared commitment to innovation will help accelerate the adoption of AI-driven solutions, enhancing the driving experience and pushing the entire industry forward." Autobrains is set to redefine the future of driving in China and globally with its pioneering technology - known for its exceptional edge case detection, remarkably low power consumption, and for being hardware agnostic. This strategic partnership and implementation of Liquid AI technology into mass production exemplifies Autobrains' commitment to global market expansion and underscores our relentless pursuit of innovation in the automotive sector.
